So there’s this girl that I like 👉🏼👈🏼

I first saw her at a festival in my hometown almost a year ago. It was literally like a movie 😭 my heart started beating like crazy and even my homies were like “wtf bro” 💀

I was going to approach her, but she was with her family, so I backed out and left it in God’s hands.

And somehow, almost a year later, I found her again through a mutual friend. We’ve met now, but barely — mostly in a group.

The funny part is… she recently broke up with her boyfriend, and now I’m stuck wondering what I’m supposed to do 😭

I don’t want to be that guy who waits forever for the “perfect moment,” but I also don’t want to rush into something with someone I barely know.

I think I actually want to get to know her first, see if the vibe is real, and then maybe ask her out.

So yeah… I’m somewhere between “let it happen naturally” and “bro just make a move already” 😭🥀

I've got a crush on one of my cousins.
I first met her in college, and it's been almost a year since I last saw her. Yet, I still remember those nine eye contacts we had.
But the scary part? Whenever I smiled at her—not in a romantic way, just a normal smile as a cousin—her expressions seemed unusual. I can't even describe them properly. It was almost as if she thought I was some kind of pervert. 😭
There were two moments when she actually smiled, but her friend was there too, so maybe they were sharing an inside joke. Maybe those smiles weren't even meant for me.
And those nine eye contacts? I couldn't even figure out what they meant because my ass kept getting nervous and looking away. 💀
The first time I saw her, I went home and immediately searched for her Instagram account. Thankfully, we already had mutual followers, so finding her wasn't difficult.
But following her? That's a whole different story.
Even though we're cousins, we barely meet or interact. So following her feels so intentional that after a year of gap, my brain has started coming up with elaborate scenarios just to make it look casual. 😭
I've spent so much time thinking about one damn button that my productive tasks have been piling up, and even my sleep has been getting messed up. But I don't blame her. She hasn't even done anything.
And now, I've finally deactivated my Instagram account for seven days.
Hopefully, this break will give me enough peace to gather the courage to click that hell of a button when I come back.
